definitions.gloss: unrelated, having no connection, nothing to do with
definitions.explanation: Having no relationship, connection, or involvement with something. Used to express that something is completely irrelevant to or separate from one's life or experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無縁|むえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I lead a life that has nothing to do with crime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ギャンブル→ギャンブル：10811_gyanburu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無縁|むえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: He is someone who has nothing to do with gambling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無縁|むえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧がちだ。
examples.english: When you live in the city, you tend to lead a life disconnected from nature.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Typically used in the pattern ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無縁|むえん} (having nothing to do with ~) or as a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective: {無縁|むえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧ (an unrelated world).

USAGE:
Combines ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) and ⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧ (connection, ties). Also has a Buddhist meaning of having no karmic connection, and in modern social contexts, {無縁|むえん}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧ (disconnected society) refers to the growing problem of social isolation in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無縁|むえん}: having nothing to do with ~
- {無縁|むえん}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧: disconnected society
- {無縁|むえん}{仏|ぼとけ}: unclaimed dead (Buddhist term)
- {無縁|むえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧: a world one has no connection to
